derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical enumeration only; emits directed left/right pairs with no disposition. Does not infer SAME_ENTITY from name similarity.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is commercially relevant CRM accounts joined to their candidate billing names, governing contracts, and registry rows per purpose B required_link_pattern.
derivations.required_premise: Each in-scope CRM account has at least one invoice billed name, governing contract header, and registry candidate reachable through source joins.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Prior identity_judgment rows may be used to filter already-adjudicated pairs but must not invent missing pairs.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED on a candidate pair does not remove the pair from the candidate universe; it remains a required link for purpose B output.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Includes open invoices only when the billing-to-contract identity join path has SAME_ENTITY and no UNRESOLVED link on that path. Unresolved invoice_contract_association blocks inclusion even when identity is otherwise resolved.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Complete over open source_invoice rows that participate in an invoice_contract_association with a resolvable billing-to-contract identity path.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association tuple exists for the invoice-contract pair under review.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_liveness_judgment ACTIVE/INACTIVE may annotate liveness but open-invoice membership does not require liveness adjudication.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_liveness_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED or empty when schedule metadata still supports downstream purpose C prong evaluation

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Row inclusion follows active_contract_and_acquisition_clause. association renders asserted only when invoice_contract_association.disposition='asserted'; all other association states render unresolved. No negative association disposition exists.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every represented invoice tied to an active contract bearing at least one ACCEPT acquisition-relevant clause appears once, with association asserted or unresolved.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association links the invoice to a contract that has acquisition_clause_judgment.disposition=ACCEPT for at least one purpose A acquisition-relevant kind.
derivations.optional_enrichment: When contract_liveness_judgment is empty, source_contract_schedule expiry text ('not renewed') supplies INACTIVE; otherwise the contract is treated ACTIVE for inclusion.
blocking_unresolved_state: absence of acquisition_clause_judgment.disposition=ACCEPT excludes the invoice row
non_blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association.disposition in ('unresolved', 'UNRESOLVED', '') still includes the invoice with association=unresolved
identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED does not exclude the invoice; it forces association=unresolved
contract_liveness_judgment.disposition empty with non-expired schedule metadata

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps identity_judgment.disposition to epistemic SAME_ENTITY | DISTINCT | UNRESOLVED. Absence of SAME_ENTITY is not DISTINCT. REJECT maps to DISTINCT per purpose contract.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Complete when every commercially required cross-source identity link demanded by purpose B appears with an explicit epistemic value.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment row exists with non-empty disposition for each required directed pair.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_link_candidates may be used as the completeness universe receipt; output is sourced from adjudicated identity_judgment rows.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment.disposition=UNRESOLVED is emitted as epistemic=UNRESOLVED and does not imply DISTINCT
missing identity_link_candidates rows do not block output when identity_judgment is populated

derivations.epistemic_behavior: status=dependent requires both dependency prongs and no blocking unresolved identity or association state. status=unresolved is explicit; not-dependent rows are omitted (no closed-world negative).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Includes every active counterparty-contract candidate with at least one ACCEPT obligation kind, reporting dependent or unresolved explicitly.
derivations.required_premise: Active contract with obligation_kind_judgment.disposition=ACCEPT for exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term.
derivations.optional_enrichment: open_invoices_by_contract supplies open_invoice_ids when joins are not blocked; otherwise open invoices are recomputed from source_invoice plus identity and association gates.
blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association.disposition not asserted when open invoices support prong 1
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_liveness_judgment.disposition empty when schedule metadata shows non-expired term
commercial_dependency_judgment.status empty; derivation recomputes status from prongs and join gates

limitations: identity_link_candidates is registered in world.sqlite with SQL filtering identity_judgment.disposition=''; that derivation produced zero rows in P6 and is not re-run here. Purpose B output reads adjudicated identity_judgment directly.
contract_liveness_judgment has no admitted ACTIVE/INACTIVE dispositions; purpose A and C infer liveness from source_contract_schedule when disposition is empty.
commercial_dependency_judgment has no admitted dependent/unresolved status values; purpose C output recomputes status from obligation, invoice, identity, and association inputs.
open_invoices_by_contract remains empty in world.sqlite; purpose C recomputes open invoice membership inline using the same blocking rules documented above.
invoice_contract_association stores UNRESOLVED (uppercase) for six tuples and empty disposition for two; all non-asserted values render as association/status unresolved in purpose outputs.
